description: This file defines a ValidatorActionFilter class implementing IActionFilter to validate model state in ASP.NET Core MVC. It serializes validation errors into JSON and sets an HTTP 422 status if the model state is invalid.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An ActionFilter that checks model validity before executing an action, returning JSON-formatted validation errors with HTTP 422 status when applicable.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, serializes errors into JSON and sets the response with status code 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty implementation, called after an action executes.
